source_review.decision_rule: Prefer the strongest free datasource for historical backtest completeness; keep official/manual sources optional.

chosen_source.label: Yahoo Finance via yfinance
chosen_source.rationale: Best balance of free historical coverage, scriptability, and existing repo support for repeatable backtests.

alternatives.label: SET website scraping
alternatives.rationale: Useful for official spot checks, but bulk historical depth and scraper stability are weaker than the primary Yahoo path.

alternatives.label: Investing.com scraping
alternatives.rationale: Can help with ad hoc market-history checks, but HTML scraping is brittle and less reusable for a single-source research pipeline.

alternatives.label: SmartXL trial workflow
alternatives.rationale: Trial-based spreadsheet access is not durable enough for a reproducible free pipeline or unattended refresh jobs.
